newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO SUFFER FIRST LEAGUE DEFEAT OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO SUFFER FIRST LEAGUE DEFEAT OF SEASON.

text.p: Portuguese champions Porto suffered their first defeat of the season when they were beaten 2-1 at home by Salgueiros on Sunday but still retained a comfortable 13-point lead at the top of the first division.
Benfica beat Uniao de Leiria 1-0 at home to move at least temporarily into second place on 43 points, two ahead of Sporting who could regain the spot when they visit lowly Maritimo on Monday.
Porto, who had not lost a league or European Cup match this season, found themselves 2-0 down 16 minutes into the game.

"The team just didn't deliver the goods. It was a black day but all teams have those and we'll just have to think carefully about where we went wrong and plan for our next game," coach Antonio Oliveira said.
Salgueiros opened the scoring two minutes after kick-off with a header just inside the post from Yugoslav Stevan Milovac.
Porto narrowly failed to equalise in the 10th minute when Brazilian winger Edmilson Pimenta hit the post.
Six minutes later Salgueiros extended their lead after a counter attack which drew Porto keeper Henrique Hilario off his line and left Luis Carlos an open goal.

Porto stepped up the pressure in the second half but Salgueiros clung on to their lead despite being reduced to 10 men in the 74th minute after Xico Fonseca was sent off for a second bookable offence.
Porto defender Joao Manuel Pinto pushed up front to give Porto their consolation goal eight minutes from the final whistle.
Benfica were unimpressive in their victory over lowly Uniao de Leiria.
After a goalless first half the hosts scored in the 75th minute when winger Edgar Pacheco scored from a goalmouth scramble after a freekick by Brazilian midfielder Jamir Gomes.
